summary.text: Explanation and diagram (Figure 2) showing how standardized product master data acts as a common language linking supply chain partners (manufacturers, procurers, ministries of health, donors, shippers, regulators, warehouses, health facilities, and patients) with end-to-end supply chain processes from forecasting and procurement to dispensing and recalls.

sections.extract: 2  Introduction Why is Product Master Data important? Product master data is central to all operational processes across supply chain partners. It ensures that each entity uniformly understands the transactional information exchanged throughout the supply chain. Acting as a common language, product master data links all supply chain data—including orders, shipments, and inventory— from manufacturing to dispensing.
